head_commit.message:
fix(devcontainer): switch to universal:2 with moby false for DinD

Two faults in the prior config kept docker from installing:
  enableNonRootDocker was string 'true' not boolean
  default moby:true fails silently on Debian/Ubuntu bases

universal:2 image ships sudo + docker prerequisites. moby:false installs
Docker CE instead. post-start verifies daemon before launching Hindsight.
